title: Expose a side-effect-free delegation diagnostic surface: durable fences, persist worker health, delivery phase
outcome: Follow-up from the tm-53e3 diagnosis (2026-09-06): the only live evidence available today comes from the health and state GETs, which carry no durability or worker-health information, and the delegation GET (get_delegation) has recovery, detach, commit and resume side effects, so it cannot be used as a diagnostic. This task adds a read-only surface (GET, no state mutation, no recovery) reporting per delegation the last durable record fence (accepted attempt, wait registration), the persist worker error count and backlog depth, the delivery phase (accepted, dispatched, provider-acknowledged, interrupted) and the runtime turn identity the parent is waiting on. Acceptance: a test proves the route performs no mutation across a delegation in every phase; the fields are documented in the delegation feature brief; the live instance can be inspected without touching its store.
disposal_reason: NOT PLANNED (backlog triage w-930e4d333f07, 2026-10-05; Greg's approval via Engram::Advisor #293). P3/P4, never started, no holder or children, untouched since before 2026-09-21, not reliability, data safety or pilot. The record is kept; reopen or re-file if it becomes relevant.
